name: Amount And Quantity Ratio 3
definition: Ratio expressed as amount per quantity.

CoexistenceQuantityRule.definition: During ISO 15022 – 20022 coexistence, Quantity length must not be greater than 15, including the decimal point. In this message subset, a restricted data type was implemented to comply with this coexistence rule.

CoexistenceAmountRule.definition: During ISO 15022 – 20022 coexistence, Amount length must not be greater than 15, including the decimal point. In this message subset, a restricted data type was implemented to comply with this coexistence rule.
